items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the public health law and the penal law, in relation to
prohibiting the falsification of COVID-19 vaccination records
items.lawCode: Add §2183, Pub Health L; add §§190.90 & 190.91, Pen L
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S4516

SPONSOR: KAPLAN
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the public health law and the penal law, in relation to
prohibiting the falsification of COVID-19 vaccination records

 
PURPOSE:

This legislation creates the crimes of falsification of COVID-19 records
in the first and second degree.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 adds a new section to the Public Health Law, this section
creates a definition for COVID-19 vaccination record card, as well as
for Digital Vaccine Passport.  Further this section also states that no
individual shall intentionally falsify or alter either to misrepresent
such individual's history and record of vaccine treatment and that
falsification shall be a crime pursuant to sections further created in
this legislation.

Section 2 adds two new sections to the Penal law to create the penalty
for the falsification of COVID-19 vaccination records in the second
degree when an individual is not a licensed medical professional and
intentionally or knowingly falsifies or alters a COVID-19 vaccination
record card or digital vaccine passport to misrepresent a history and
record of vaccine treatment. This would be a class A misdemeanor.  Also
creates the penalty for the falsification of COVID-19 vaccination
records in the first degree when an individual is a licensed medical
professional and intentionally or knowingly falsifies or alters a
COVID-19 vaccination record card or digital vaccine passport to misrep-
resent a history and record of vaccine treatment. This would be a class
E felony.

Section 3 is the effective date. .

 
JUSTIFICATION:

This legislation seeks to protect the assuredness of COVID-19 vaccine
records. Individuals who misrepresent their vaccination history, not
only jeopardize their own health, but the health of all those they come
into contact with. This legislation speaks to the incredibly serious
level of concern COVID-19 brings to our society. By creating a specific
crime for the falsification of records we make it easier for law
enforcement to specifically be able to charge individuals who undertake
nefarious means to receive a COVID-19 vaccination record.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

None. FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

B.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S4516B

SPONSOR: KAPLAN
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the penal law, in relation to making the falsification
of COVID-19 vaccination records a crime

 
PURPOSE:

This legislation adds clarification that a COVID Vaccination Card shall
be considered a written instrument.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 amends the definition of Written Instrument to include a card
provided to a person by a vaccine provider indicating the date a person
received a vaccination against COVID-19 as well as the written type of
vaccine and its lot number shall be considered a written instrument.

Section 2 amends the penal law to add she to Section 156.25 of the Penal
Law, as well as to add the crime of when he or she intentionally alters
in any manner or destroys computer material indicating that a person did
or did not receive a vaccination against COVID-19.

Section 3 is the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

This legislation seeks to protect the assuredness of COVID-19 vaccine
records. Individuals who misrepresent their vaccination history, not
only jeopardize their own health, but the health of all those they come
into contact with. This legislation speaks to the incredibly serious
level of concern COVID-19 brings to our society. As New York is opening
up it makes presentation of proof of vaccine even more important for
certain activities.

This legislation speaks to the importance these records will have in
supporting the goals of increasing public health.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

None.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

C.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S4516C

SPONSOR: KAPLAN
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the penal law, in relation to making the falsification
of COVID-19 vaccination records a crime

 
PURPOSE:

This legislation adds clarification that a COVID Vaccination Card shall
be considered a written instrument. This bill adds language to computer
tampering in the third degree when a person intentionally alters or
destroys computer material indicating a person did or did not receive a
vaccination against COVID-19.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 amends the definition of Written Instrument to include a card
bearing a government logo or other indication it was created by a
governmental instrumentality provided to a person by a vaccine provider
indicating the date a person received a vaccination against COVID-19 as
well as the written type of vaccine and its lot number shall be consid-
ered a written instrument.

Section 2 amends the penal law to add to Section 156.25 of the Penal Law
by adding to computer tampering in the third degree, language covering
when someone intentionally alters in any manner or destroys computer
material indicating that a person did or did not receive a vaccination
against COVID19.

Section 3 is the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

This legislation seeks to protect the assuredness of COVID-19 vaccine
records. Individuals who misrepresent their vaccination history, not
only jeopardize their own health, but the health of all those they come
into contact with. This legislation speaks to the incredibly serious
level of concern COVID-19 brings to our society. As New York is opening
up it makes presentation of proof of vaccine even more important for
certain activities.

This legislation speaks to the importance these records will have in
supporting the goals of increasing public health.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

None.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

approvalMessage.text:
APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 139 Chapter 784
 
       MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 4516-C, entitled:
 
    "AN ACT to amend the penal law, in relation to making the falsifica-
        tion of COVID-19 vaccination records a crime"
 
    APPROVED
 
  Over  32  million  doses of COVID-19 vaccine have been administered to
date and individuals are issued a vaccine card as proof. As  businesses,
schools,  hospitals and governments increasingly require proof of vacci-
nation, there is an elevated need to protect the public from  those  who
seek  to use fraudulent vaccine cards. The public health threat posed to
communities by schemes in which  vaccine  cards  are  forged,  sold  and
passed off as real, is truly alarming.
 
  This  legislation  adds clarification that a COVID-19 Vaccination Card
shall be considered a written instrument for  purposes  of  the  forgery
statute,  which  makes the falsification of COVID-19 Vaccination Cards a
class D felony. It also creates a new E felony of computer tampering  in
the  third degree for intentional entering, alteration or destruction of
"computer material" regarding COVID-19 vaccine  provisions.  Individuals
who  misrepresent  their  vaccination history, not only jeopardize their
own health, but the health of all those they  come  into  contact  with.
This  legislation  ensures that as New York opens up and many businesses
choose to rely on checking  vaccination  status,  the  falsification  of
vaccination records will not be tolerated.
 
  In  order  to  include individuals who intentionally enter information
into computer material indicating that a person did or did not receive a
vaccination against COVID-19, in  addition  to  altering  or  destroying
computer  material related to the same, I have secured an agreement with
the Legislature to make certain changes to the bill.
 
  On the basis of this agreement, I am pleased to sign this bill.
 
  This bill is approved.                         (signed) KATHY HOCHUL
 
                                ______

summary: Makes the falsification of COVID-19 vaccination records a crime as part of computer tampering in the third degree which is a class E felony.
